1w8e5gy.q: The sign shown warns of a long straight
1w8e5gy.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on both sides (strettoia simmetrica); it has nothing to do with a long straight.

v29zy2.q: The sign shown warns of a tunnel entrance
v29zy2.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on both sides (strettoia simmetrica); tunnels have their own sign.

zv7pxf.q: The sign shown is a regulatory sign
zv7pxf.why: The red-bordered triangle makes it a danger sign: it warns, but does not impose obligations or bans like regulatory signs (segnali di prescrizione).

1s4fszh.q: The sign shown warns of a one-way street
1s4fszh.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on both sides (strettoia simmetrica); a one-way street is shown on a blue rectangular sign.

1key9fe.q: The sign shown warns of an acceleration lane
1key9fe.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on both sides (strettoia simmetrica), not an acceleration lane, which actually widens the road.

1dpat8s.q: The sign shown warns of a narrowing of the carriageway
1dpat8s.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra).

1osi5wh.q: The sign shown warns of a narrow passage on the left side of the carriageway
1osi5wh.why: In the symbol it is the left line that bends inward, so the narrowing is on the left side.

1mq16qz.q: The sign shown warns of a dangerous narrowing on the left of the carriageway
1mq16qz.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra).

6qv7aj.q: The sign shown warns of a narrow passage with likely difficulty in passing oncoming vehicles
6qv7aj.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra), the side oncoming vehicles use, so passing them may be difficult.

q1ul3w.q: The sign shown requires you to moderate your speed and, if necessary, to stop
q1ul3w.why: At the narrowing you must slow down and, if there is not enough room to pass oncoming vehicles, stop.

bzz2e3.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
bzz2e3.why: A triangular shape with a red border identifies danger signs (segnali di pericolo); this one warns of a narrowing on the left.

jbn2ay.q: The sign shown, if on a yellow background, is placed where roadworks reduce the width of the carriageway
jbn2ay.why: With a yellow background the sign marks a temporary hazard linked to roadworks, here a work site (cantiere) that narrows the carriageway.

nvdb4j.q: The sign shown is a regulatory sign
nvdb4j.why: The red-bordered triangle makes it a danger sign, not a regulatory sign (segnale di prescrizione) imposing obligations or bans.

1kisfb6.q: The sign shown warns of a road merging from the left
1kisfb6.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra); a merging road has its own sign showing a side road joining.

1nhu9sw.q: The sign shown warns of a road with a series of bends
1nhu9sw.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra); bends have their own signs.

1cdgaon.q: The sign shown warns of a flyover
1cdgaon.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra), not a flyover (cavalcavia).

1eo7odf.q: The sign shown warns of a pedestrian underpass
1eo7odf.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra), not a pedestrian underpass.

z83zbk.q: The sign shown warns of a narrowing on the right of the carriageway
z83zbk.why: In the symbol the left line bends inward, so the narrowing is on the left, not the right.

tyzcbs.q: The sign shown warns of a high kerb separating the lanes
tyzcbs.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra); it is not about kerbs separating lanes.

8rpo57.q: The sign shown warns of a slippery stretch of road
8rpo57.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the left side (strettoia asimmetrica a sinistra); a slippery road has its own sign showing a skidding car.

l9h8p5.q: The sign shown warns of a narrow passage on the right of the carriageway
l9h8p5.why: In the symbol it is the right line that bends inward, so the narrowing is on the right side.

1ca2od6.q: The sign shown warns of a narrow passage caused by a fixed obstacle on the right side
1ca2od6.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra), for example due to a low wall or another fixed obstacle.

7s3n90.q: The sign shown warns of a dangerous narrowing on the right of the carriageway
7s3n90.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra).

k81acy.q: The sign shown warns of the carriageway narrowing because of low walls or another obstacle on the right side
k81acy.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra), caused by low walls or other obstacles.

1o13nai.q: The sign shown may also be found on a two-way road
1o13nai.why: A narrowing can occur on both one-way and two-way roads; on a two-way road it can make passing oncoming traffic difficult.

mjd1ch.q: The sign shown, if on a yellow background, is placed where roadworks reduce the width of the carriageway
mjd1ch.why: With a yellow background the sign marks a temporary hazard linked to roadworks, here a work site (cantiere) that narrows the carriageway.

1nyh3ey.q: The sign shown indicates the end of two-way traffic
1nyh3ey.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra); it does not mark the end of two-way traffic.

cj9dq8.q: The sign shown requires you to give way to vehicles coming from the opposite direction
cj9dq8.why: This danger sign warns of the narrowing but sets no priority; a duty to give way to oncoming traffic comes from a specific round sign.

lux8jg.q: The sign shown authorises driving in parallel rows
lux8jg.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra): space is reduced, so it does not allow driving in parallel rows.

srt8gc.q: The sign shown indicates that you should line up in two rows
srt8gc.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra); it does not tell you to form two rows.

11xplsj.q: The sign shown warns of a road merging from the right
11xplsj.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra); a merging road has its own sign showing a side road joining.

usxxnx.q: The sign shown warns of the start of a one-way street
usxxnx.why: The sign warns of a road narrowing on the right side (strettoia asimmetrica a destra); a one-way street is shown on a blue rectangular sign.

w7i5oo.q: The sign shown warns of a movable bridge
w7i5oo.why: The symbol of a raised bridge over water warns of a movable bridge (ponte mobile), which may open to let boats through.

ne0oex.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
ne0oex.why: A triangular shape with a red border identifies danger signs (segnali di pericolo); this one warns of a movable bridge.

1ncyl89.q: The sign shown may be supplemented with a panel showing the operating or opening times of a movable bridge
1ncyl89.why: The movable bridge sign can be completed by a supplementary panel (pannello integrativo) giving the bridge's operating times.

yx3i4t.q: After the sign shown we may find a device with flashing red lights
yx3i4t.why: Before the movable bridge there may be flashing red lights that signal when the bridge is being raised or lowered.

9dwtjx.q: The sign shown requires you to stop if the flashing red lights are operating
9dwtjx.why: Flashing red lights mean the movable bridge is in operation: you must stop and wait until they go off.

1g5umke.q: The sign shown can be supplemented by the distance panel with three red bars
1g5umke.why: The movable bridge sign can be paired with the three-red-bar distance panel (pannello distanziometrico), showing the distance to the bridge as at level crossings.

1in8kny.q: The sign shown warns of a port area
1in8kny.why: The sign warns of a movable bridge (ponte mobile), a lifting or swing bridge that opens to let boats pass. It does not indicate a port area.

clibeb.q: The sign shown requires you to stop before crossing the bridge
clibeb.why: It is a danger sign warning of a movable bridge; it does not require stopping, which is needed only if the bridge is open or signalled closed.

15vcykt.q: The sign shown warns of a bridge with a steep gradient
15vcykt.why: The sign warns of a movable bridge (ponte mobile), a lifting or swing bridge that opens to let boats pass. It does not refer to a steep gradient.

1na6n5f.q: The sign shown requires you to give way to vehicles coming from the opposite direction
1na6n5f.why: The sign warns of a movable bridge (ponte mobile), a lifting or swing bridge that opens to let boats pass. Giving way to oncoming traffic is shown by a different, regulatory sign.

buvsf2.q: The sign shown prohibits overtaking if placed on the access road to a port area
buvsf2.why: It is a danger sign for a movable bridge: it has nothing to do with port areas and does not prohibit overtaking.

1em2tf8.q: The sign shown warns of a level crossing with barriers
1em2tf8.why: The sign warns of a movable bridge (ponte mobile), a lifting or swing bridge that opens to let boats pass. A level crossing with barriers has a different sign showing a gate.

xltl33.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road that can become dangerous in particular weather conditions specified on the supplementary panels
xltl33.why: The slippery road sign can be completed by supplementary panels showing the cause, such as rain or ice.

1p7jktn.q: The sign shown warns of a road whose surface can become particularly slippery
1p7jktn.why: The slippery road sign (strada sdrucciolevole) warns of a stretch where tyre grip can drop, for example in rain or ice.

1sdwk21.q: Sign (A), combined with panel (B), warns of a road whose surface is particularly slippery in case of rain
1sdwk21.why: The supplementary panel showing a cloud and rain specifies that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

stj2vk.q: Sign (A), if combined with panel (B), warns of a stretch of road where ice is likely in particular weather conditions
stj2vk.why: The supplementary panel with snowflakes specifies that the slipperiness is due to likely ice (ghiaccio).

1uanix0.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where tyre grip may decrease
1uanix0.why: The slippery road sign (strada sdrucciolevole) warns of a stretch where tyre grip can drop, for example in rain or ice.

1g3x7ya.q: The sign shown requires driving at moderate speed and avoiding sudden manoeuvres
1g3x7ya.why: On a slippery road you must slow down and avoid sudden braking, accelerating or steering, which can make the vehicle skid.

86jers.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must reduce speed and avoid sudden braking in case of rain
86jers.why: Rain reduces grip: sudden braking can lock the wheels and make the vehicle skid.

wce3qt.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must reduce speed and avoid sudden acceleration in case of ice
wce3qt.why: On ice grip is minimal: sudden acceleration makes the driven wheels spin and can cause loss of control.

vl7jqv.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must reduce speed and avoid sudden steering in case of rain
vl7jqv.why: Rain reduces grip: sudden steering can make the vehicle skid.

s92ffo.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must reduce speed and bear in mind that the safety distance increases in case of ice
s92ffo.why: On ice the braking distance grows considerably, so you must slow down and keep a longer safety distance (distanza di sicurezza).

6hhr1w.q: The sign shown warns of a road narrowing
6hhr1w.why: The slippery road sign (strada sdrucciolevole) warns of a stretch where tyre grip can drop, for example in rain or ice. A road narrowing (strettoia) has a different sign.

181f9ne.q: The sign shown warns of the possibility of skidding due to strong crosswind
181f9ne.why: The slippery road sign (strada sdrucciolevole) warns of a stretch where tyre grip can drop, for example in rain or ice. Crosswind (vento laterale) has a different sign showing a windsock.

aexi0q.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where tyre grip increases
aexi0q.why: The sign warns of a stretch where tyre grip decreases, not increases, because the road can become slippery.

1w0fmoo.q: The sign shown warns that on that road the braking distance decreases
1w0fmoo.why: On a slippery road grip drops, so the braking distance (spazio di frenatura) increases, not decreases.

p33h03.q: The sign shown invites you to reduce the safety distance
p33h03.why: On a slippery road the braking distance grows, so the safety distance must be increased, not reduced.

jt5a32.q: The sign shown warns of a road with many bends
jt5a32.why: The slippery road sign (strada sdrucciolevole) warns of a stretch where tyre grip can drop, for example in rain or ice. Bends are shown by other danger signs.

ls6elm.q: The sign shown warns of a track for testing tyre grip
ls6elm.why: The sign warns drivers that the road can become slippery; it does not indicate any test track.

ep6985.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must bear in mind that the braking distance decreases in case of rain
ep6985.why: In rain grip drops and the braking distance increases, not decreases.

zdehu9.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must reduce the distance from the vehicle ahead in case of rain
zdehu9.why: In rain the braking distance grows, so the distance from the vehicle ahead must be increased.

o3op60.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must accelerate sharply in case of rain
o3op60.why: On a slippery road you must avoid sharp acceleration, which makes the wheels spin; you must keep speed moderate.

x4yzym.q: In the presence of the sign shown, overtaking is always prohibited when it rains
x4yzym.why: This danger sign does not prohibit overtaking: it calls for caution and moderate speed; overtaking is banned only by specific signs or rules.

gusjuf.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must brake sharply in case of ice
gusjuf.why: On ice you must avoid sharp braking, which locks the wheels and causes skidding; brake gently and keep speed low.

5tqraf.q: The sign shown prohibits vehicles with mud-covered wheels from passing
5tqraf.why: It is a danger sign warning of a slippery road; it does not prohibit any vehicle from passing.

cird0d.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must fit snow chains
cird0d.why: The slippery road sign calls for caution, not snow chains; the chains or winter tyres requirement is shown by a specific mandatory sign.

umuovr.q: The sign shown can warn of a school attended by children nearby
umuovr.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby.

1lew6sj.q: The sign shown can be placed near a playground used by children
1lew6sj.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby.

lnwe52.q: The sign shown warns of places frequented by children
lnwe52.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby.

1ll0m4k.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
1ll0m4k.why: The children sign is triangular with a red border, the shape of danger signs (segnali di pericolo).

jykseh.q: The sign shown can be placed near public gardens used by children
jykseh.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby.

1i3cap2.q: The sign shown invites you to drive at moderate speed
1i3cap2.why: Near places used by children you must slow down so you can stop if a child suddenly crosses.

1v5s9nb.q: The sign shown invites you to take into account possible careless behaviour by children
1v5s9nb.why: Children can behave unpredictably and carelessly, such as running across the road: the sign asks you to anticipate this.

1906tiu.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must pay particular attention to the possible presence of children
1906tiu.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby. You must therefore pay extra attention.

r6ns5q.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must reduce speed and watch out for children even if they are on the pavement
r6ns5q.why: Children on the pavement (marciapiede) can suddenly step into the road, so you must watch them too.

1fxldi4.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must pay particular attention to children's unpredictable movements
1fxldi4.why: Children's movements are unpredictable: they may run into the road without looking, so you must slow down and pay attention.

1x2wnjt.q: In the presence of the sign shown, it is prohibited to overtake vehicles that have stopped to let children cross
1x2wnjt.why: You must not overtake vehicles stopped to let children cross, because the stopped vehicle hides whoever is crossing.

19tgm0m.q: The sign shown prohibits unaccompanied children from passing
19tgm0m.why: It is a danger sign warning that children may be present; it does not prohibit anyone from passing.

15rmq3r.q: The sign shown warns of a pedestrian crossing
15rmq3r.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby. A pedestrian crossing has a different sign showing a pedestrian on stripes.

1cjzb7l.q: The sign shown indicates the end of an avenue reserved for children
1cjzb7l.why: It is a danger sign warning of places used by children; it does not mark the start or end of any reserved avenue.

1n9rz9w.q: The sign shown warns of a pedestrian path
1n9rz9w.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby. A pedestrian path is shown by a round blue mandatory sign.

wk3iy9.q: The sign shown prohibits motor vehicles from passing when children are leaving school
wk3iy9.why: The children sign warns of a hazard and never prohibits passing at any time; it only requires caution and moderate speed.

90m0sv.q: The sign shown indicates a school bus stop
90m0sv.why: The children sign (bambini) is a danger sign warning that places used by children, such as schools, parks or playgrounds, are nearby. It does not mark a school bus stop.

wueifd.q: The sign shown is placed on the rear of the school bus
wueifd.why: It is a roadside danger sign placed near places used by children; school buses carry their own distinct marking.

17j3fni.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must watch out for children on the carriageway and not those on the pavement
17j3fni.why: You must watch both children on the carriageway and those on the pavement (marciapiede), who may suddenly step into the road.

ecblvs.q: In the presence of the sign shown, passing is prohibited when children are leaving school
ecblvs.why: The children sign never prohibits passing at any time: it is a danger sign requiring caution and moderate speed.

rsuw58.q: In the presence of the sign shown, it is prohibited to exceed 30 km/h
rsuw58.why: The children sign does not set a specific speed limit: it asks you to moderate speed according to the circumstances.

1j3b325.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road where domestic animals are likely to cross
1j3b325.why: The domestic animals sign (animali domestici) warns that stray farm animals such as cattle may be on or crossing the road.

ax20ej.q: The sign shown requires you to slow down or stop if the animals on the road show signs of fear
ax20ej.why: Frightened animals can move unpredictably: you must slow down and, if necessary, stop.

ppaus4.q: The sign shown requires you to slow down or stop if the animals on the road do not move away
ppaus4.why: If animals block the road and do not move, you must slow down and, if necessary, stop without frightening them.

1vmh8uu.q: The sign shown warns that you may find stray domestic animals on the road
1vmh8uu.why: The domestic animals sign (animali domestici) warns that stray farm animals such as cattle may be on or crossing the road.

1cx7zwa.q: The sign shown invites you to be careful because domestic animals are likely to be on the carriageway
1cx7zwa.why: The domestic animals sign (animali domestici) warns that stray farm animals such as cattle may be on or crossing the road.

156xuib.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must repeatedly use the horn to drive the animals away
156xuib.why: Repeatedly using the horn (avvisatore acustico) can frighten animals and make them unpredictable; you must slow down and stop if needed.

e7uzn.q: The sign shown warns of a grazing area where motor vehicles are prohibited
e7uzn.why: The domestic animals sign (animali domestici) warns that stray farm animals such as cattle may be on or crossing the road. It is a danger sign and does not prohibit traffic.

1hxl1gi.q: The sign shown warns of a road reserved for domestic animals
1hxl1gi.why: The domestic animals sign (animali domestici) warns that stray farm animals such as cattle may be on or crossing the road. The road stays open to vehicles and is not reserved for animals.

1fno904.q: The sign shown warns of animal-drawn vehicles
1fno904.why: The domestic animals sign (animali domestici) warns that stray farm animals such as cattle may be on or crossing the road. It does not refer to animal-drawn vehicles.

2zb6f1.q: The sign shown warns of a farm in open countryside
2zb6f1.why: The domestic animals sign (animali domestici) warns that stray farm animals such as cattle may be on or crossing the road. It does not indicate a farm.

dpoyc1.q: The sign shown warns that wild animals are likely to cross
dpoyc1.why: The wild animals sign (animali selvatici) warns that wild animals such as deer may suddenly cross the road.

fg5jss.q: The sign shown requires you to slow down and, if necessary, stop if the animals show signs of fear
fg5jss.why: Frightened wild animals can move unpredictably: you must slow down and, if necessary, stop.

1pqb4lc.q: The sign shown requires you to slow down and, if necessary, stop if animals suddenly cross the road
1pqb4lc.why: Wild animals can cross without warning: you must slow down and be ready to stop to avoid a collision.

lm0ja8.q: The sign shown warns that you may suddenly find stray animals on the carriageway
lm0ja8.why: The wild animals sign (animali selvatici) warns that wild animals such as deer may suddenly cross the road.

1b3tua.q: The sign shown warns that wild animals are likely to cross suddenly
1b3tua.why: The wild animals sign (animali selvatici) warns that wild animals such as deer may suddenly cross the road.

gpzxzq.q: The sign shown requires you to slow down to avoid hitting stray wild animals
gpzxzq.why: Driving slower lets you stop in time if a wild animal suddenly crosses.

15hh5e2.q: In the presence of the sign shown, you must repeatedly use the horn to drive the animals away
15hh5e2.why: Repeatedly using the horn (avvisatore acustico) can frighten animals and make them unpredictable; you must slow down and stop if needed.

jo0q2m.q: The sign shown warns of an area reserved for wild animals
jo0q2m.why: The wild animals sign (animali selvatici) warns that wild animals such as deer may suddenly cross the road. The road stays open to vehicles.

1553rt0.q: The sign shown requires you to drive in the middle of the road to avoid hitting wild animals
1553rt0.why: The sign asks you to slow down and stop if needed; you keep driving on the right side of the carriageway.

k8jbr3.q: The sign shown allows only four-wheel-drive vehicles to pass
k8jbr3.why: The wild animals sign (animali selvatici) warns that wild animals such as deer may suddenly cross the road. It does not restrict traffic to any type of vehicle.

dbqeli.q: The sign shown indicates the entrance of a "safari zoo"
dbqeli.why: The wild animals sign (animali selvatici) warns that wild animals such as deer may suddenly cross the road. It does not mark the entrance of a safari zoo.

1ibjl4r.q: The sign shown indicates the entrance of a National Park
1ibjl4r.why: The wild animals sign (animali selvatici) warns that wild animals such as deer may suddenly cross the road. A park entrance is shown by information signs, not danger signs.

jq5pcy.q: The sign shown warns that a one-way carriageway becomes two-way
jq5pcy.why: The two-way traffic sign (doppio senso di circolazione) warns that a one-way carriageway becomes two-way, so oncoming vehicles will appear ahead.

nvdbxa.q: The sign shown warns that, a little further on, you may meet vehicles travelling in the opposite direction
nvdbxa.why: The two-way traffic sign (doppio senso di circolazione) warns that a one-way carriageway becomes two-way, so oncoming vehicles will appear ahead.

14ffs19.q: The sign shown warns that one-way traffic is ending
14ffs19.why: The two-way traffic sign (doppio senso di circolazione) warns that a one-way carriageway becomes two-way, so oncoming vehicles will appear ahead.

r47npv.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
r47npv.why: The two-way traffic sign is triangular with a red border, the shape of danger signs (segnali di pericolo).

15wqb47.q: The sign shown indicates that, a little further on, greater caution will be needed
15wqb47.why: The two-way traffic sign (doppio senso di circolazione) warns that a one-way carriageway becomes two-way, so oncoming vehicles will appear ahead. Greater caution is needed, especially when overtaking.

5qsbqv.q: The sign shown, if on a yellow background, is placed where roadworks are in progress
5qsbqv.why: Yellow-background danger signs are temporary and used at roadworks (cantieri), for example when works move traffic onto one two-way carriageway.

onjw06.q: In the presence of the sign shown, overtaking, if permitted, must be carried out with particular care
onjw06.why: After the sign you will meet oncoming vehicles, so overtaking, where allowed, requires extra care.

1f4ba9t.q: The sign shown warns that traffic runs on two separate carriageways
1f4ba9t.why: The sign means both directions of traffic share the same carriageway, not two separate carriageways.

1kssbce.q: The sign shown warns that traffic becomes one-way
1kssbce.why: The sign means the opposite: one-way traffic ends and the road becomes two-way.

1ext52k.q: The sign shown requires giving way to vehicles coming from the opposite direction
1ext52k.why: This is the two-way traffic sign (doppio senso di circolazione): it warns that after a one-way section, traffic flows in both directions again. It imposes no duty to give way.

kzxl69.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of right of way on alternating one-way sections
kzxl69.why: The sign warns of a two-way traffic section, not right of way on an alternating one-way stretch (senso unico alternato), which is shown by specific square or round priority signs.

12y3rzo.q: The sign shown gives advance notice that you must turn back
12y3rzo.why: The sign means the road ahead becomes two-way (doppio senso di circolazione); the opposite arrows show the two directions of traffic, not a U-turn.

1hzlr4e.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an alternating one-way section
1hzlr4e.why: The sign warns of a two-way traffic section, where vehicles travel in both directions at the same time; on an alternating one-way section (senso unico alternato) only one direction passes at a time.

1ildoim.q: The sign shown is an advance warning of a mandatory direction
1ildoim.why: It is a triangular danger sign warning of two-way traffic; mandatory-direction signs are round blue mandatory signs (segnali d'obbligo).

15oj6v7.q: The sign shown warns that the road leads out onto a harbour quay
15oj6v7.why: The quayside or riverbank sign (sbocco su molo o su argine) warns that the road ends at a harbour quay, pier, or river or canal bank, with a risk of falling into the water.

20968r.q: The sign shown warns that the road leads out onto a pier
20968r.why: The sign warns that the road leads onto a pier (molo), harbour quay or embankment, where there is a risk of ending up in the water.

18yzq5i.q: The sign shown warns that the road leads out onto a river embankment
18yzq5i.why: The sign means the road comes out onto a river or canal embankment (argine), a pier or a quay: there is a risk of falling into the water.

1ip2nmq.q: The sign shown warns that the road leads out onto a canal embankment
1ip2nmq.why: The quayside or riverbank sign also covers a canal embankment (argine) and warns of the risk of falling into the water.

jhu3if.q: When you see the sign shown you must take special care, especially at night, to avoid falling into the water
jhu3if.why: The sign warns that the road leads onto a pier or embankment; at night reduced visibility makes the edge harder to see, so extra care is needed.

b3qf0r.q: The sign shown warns of the danger of falling into the water
b3qf0r.why: The sign shows a car dropping off a pier or embankment into the water: it warns precisely of the risk of falling into the water.

4a3v9h.q: When you see the sign shown you must take special care if, on the stretch of road ahead, you will have to reverse
4a3v9h.why: The sign marks a road ending on a pier or embankment: reversing near the edge is dangerous because you risk falling into the water (retromarcia = reversing).

1q3j1im.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
1q3j1im.why: It has the triangular red-bordered shape of danger signs (segnali di pericolo) and warns of a road leading onto a pier or embankment.

1u9dmz9.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a viaduct under construction
1u9dmz9.why: The sign warns that the road leads onto a pier, quay or embankment with a risk of falling into the water, not a viaduct under construction.

1h1zb3i.q: The sign shown requires stopping at a moving bridge while it is operating
1h1zb3i.why: This danger sign does not require stopping: it warns of a road leading onto a pier or embankment. A moving bridge has its own specific danger sign (ponte mobile).

1ojde2h.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road cut off by flooding
1ojde2h.why: The sign has nothing to do with floods: it warns that the road leads onto a pier or embankment, with a risk of falling into the water.

nvkvaz.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the road leading onto a moving bridge
nvkvaz.why: The sign warns of a road leading onto a pier or embankment; a moving bridge has a different danger sign showing the raised bridge (ponte mobile).

8cdpe5.q: When you see the sign shown you must take special care because you will meet a steep descent
8cdpe5.why: The sign indicates a road leading onto a pier or embankment with a risk of falling into the water; a steep descent has its own sign showing the gradient as a percentage (discesa pericolosa).

efonzf.q: The sign shown warns of the danger of storm surges
efonzf.why: The sign is not about storm surges (mareggiate): it warns that the road leads onto a pier, quay or embankment, with a risk of falling into the water.

134mzpm.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an area equipped for washing vehicles
134mzpm.why: It is a danger sign warning of a road leading onto a pier or embankment; service areas are shown by information signs, not red triangles.

18myya.q: The sign shown applies only to cars
18myya.why: The pier or embankment sign applies to all road users, because the risk of falling into the water concerns every vehicle.

kx3hyp.q: The sign shown is not valid in the summer months
kx3hyp.why: The sign is valid all year round: the risk of falling into the water from a pier or embankment exists in every season.

1rgeg92.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road where the vehicle's grip may be reduced
1rgeg92.why: The loose chippings sign (materiale instabile sulla strada) warns of gravel on the road, which reduces tyre grip.

1vcky3v.q: The sign shown requires proceeding with caution when pedestrians are present, even if they are off the carriageway
1vcky3v.why: Gravel can be thrown some distance by the wheels and hit pedestrians even off the carriageway (carreggiata), so you must proceed with caution.

1kfuzhw.q: The sign shown warns of gravel that can be thrown some distance as the vehicle passes
1kfuzhw.why: The sign shows a car throwing up stones: it warns of loose material such as gravel (pietrisco) that wheels can fling some distance.

y05wny.q: The sign shown requires reducing speed when passing another vehicle coming the other way
y05wny.why: With gravel on the road, slowing down when passing an oncoming vehicle stops thrown stones from damaging windscreens or bodywork.

14hgelg.q: When you see the sign shown it is advisable to keep a greater distance from the vehicle in front
14hgelg.why: A larger gap avoids being hit by gravel thrown up by the vehicle in front and makes up for the reduced grip when braking.

73e0je.q: The sign shown warns of the danger of finding gravel on the road surface
73e0je.why: This is the loose chippings sign (materiale instabile sulla strada): it warns of gravel or grit on the road surface.

rkshgv.q: When you see the sign shown you must consider the danger of skidding or sliding
rkshgv.why: Gravel on the road reduces grip, so sudden braking, steering or acceleration can cause skidding or sliding (sbandamento).

1qtvpje.q: The sign shown, if it has a yellow background, is placed where there are roadworks
1qtvpje.why: Any danger sign with a yellow background marks a temporary hazard linked to roadworks (cantieri stradali), for example gravel left by ongoing works.

o8fl23.q: The sign shown advises accelerating to increase the vehicle's grip on the asphalt
o8fl23.why: With gravel on the road you must slow down and avoid sudden acceleration, which further reduces grip and throws up stones.

yi1atp.q: The sign shown is a sign of prescription
yi1atp.why: It is a danger sign: it warns of loose material on the road but does not order or forbid anything, unlike prescription signs (segnali di prescrizione).

1krlsxv.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road subject to landslides
1krlsxv.why: The sign warns of loose material, i.e. gravel that wheels can throw up; for landslides the falling rocks sign (caduta massi) is used.

93psmm.q: The sign shown, if it has a yellow background, gives advance notice of a stretch of road that cannot be driven on because of roadworks
93psmm.why: The yellow background means the hazard is due to roadworks, but the road can still be used: you just proceed carefully over the gravel.

tzrcsc.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of soft verges
tzrcsc.why: The sign warns of gravel on the road; soft verges (banchine cedevoli) are shown by the 'other dangers' sign with a supplementary panel.

12lyvra.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road where there is a danger of falling rocks
12lyvra.why: The sign shows stones thrown up by a car's wheels: it indicates loose material on the road, not falling rocks, which has a sign showing a rock face (caduta massi).

1q1wei7.q: The sign shown gives advance notice that snow chains must be fitted
1q1wei7.why: It is a danger sign for gravel on the road; the snow chains requirement is given by a round blue mandatory sign (catene da neve).

15u4qoj.q: The sign shown warns of the danger of falling rocks
15u4qoj.why: This is the falling rocks sign (caduta massi): it shows a rock face with stones falling onto the road.

i96toe.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road where there is a danger of stones on the carriageway
i96toe.why: The falling rocks sign warns that stones can fall from the rock face and may therefore be lying on the carriageway (carreggiata).

1kyjaj4.q: The sign shown warns of the danger of stones falling from the left, which may then be lying on the carriageway
1kyjaj4.why: In this sign the rock face is on the left: it indicates rocks falling from the left, with stones possibly lying on the carriageway.

1hv9tlj.q: When you see the sign shown it is advisable to reduce speed to avoid hitting any rocks that have fallen onto the carriageway
1hv9tlj.why: Where rocks may fall, you must slow down so you can avoid or stop in time for stones lying on the carriageway.

1nxqi2z.q: When you see the sign shown it is advisable to avoid long stops on the stretch of road affected by the danger
1nxqi2z.why: Stopping for a long time on a stretch exposed to falling rocks increases the risk of being hit by stones, so it should be avoided.

l8wldg.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road with roadworks
l8wldg.why: The white-background sign warns of falling rocks; only a yellow-background danger sign indicates a hazard linked to roadworks (cantieri stradali).

5c2cra.q: When you see the sign shown it is advisable to sound the horn insistently
5c2cra.why: With falling rocks you must slow down and pay attention; the horn (clacson) should only be used when really necessary and sparingly.

i6wbhw.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road in poor condition or with an uneven surface
i6wbhw.why: The sign warns of falling rocks; a road in poor condition or with an uneven surface has the uneven road sign (strada deformata).

mqn3ca.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an uneven stretch of road
mqn3ca.why: The sign shows stones falling from a rock face: it indicates falling rocks, not an uneven road, which has its own sign with a bumpy profile (strada deformata).

1lipkm0.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road where overtaking is prohibited
1lipkm0.why: It is a danger sign for falling rocks and does not prohibit overtaking; the no-overtaking rule is given by a round prohibition sign (divieto di sorpasso).

1gq98vo.q: The sign shown warns of the danger of rocks falling from the right
1gq98vo.why: In this sign the rock face is on the right: it warns of the danger of rocks falling from the right (caduta massi).

kvrueh.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road where there is a danger of stones on the carriageway
kvrueh.why: The falling rocks sign means stones can break away from the rock face and end up on the carriageway (carreggiata).

1ot6mha.q: The sign shown warns of the danger of stones falling from the rock face
1ot6mha.why: The sign shows a rock face with stones breaking away: it warns precisely of the danger of falling rocks (caduta massi).

fdwn90.q: When you see the sign shown it is advisable to reduce speed to avoid hitting any rocks that have fallen onto the carriageway
fdwn90.why: Slowing down lets you spot any rocks on the carriageway in time and avoid them or stop.

mkmmu.q: When you see the sign shown you must watch out for possible sudden braking by the vehicles in front
mkmmu.why: Vehicles in front may brake suddenly to avoid rocks on the carriageway, so stay alert and keep a suitable distance.

gub96z.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a slippery stretch of road
gub96z.why: The sign warns of falling rocks; a slippery road has a different sign showing a skidding car with zigzag tracks (strada sdrucciolevole).

3awakg.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a road narrowing on the right
3awakg.why: The sign shows a rock face on the right with falling stones: it indicates rocks falling from the right, not a road narrowing (strettoia).

j925mi.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an unpaved stretch of road
j925mi.why: The sign indicates the danger of rocks falling from a rock face, not the absence of asphalt.

lin628.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of soft verges
lin628.why: The sign warns of rocks falling from the right; soft verges (banchine cedevoli) are shown with the 'other dangers' sign and a supplementary panel.

toe4mz.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a stretch of road where you may not drive faster than 30 km/h
toe4mz.why: The falling rocks sign imposes no speed limit: it only requires you to adapt your speed to the hazard. Speed limits are shown by round prohibition signs.

sas9m2.q: The sign shown warns of possible hailstorms
sas9m2.why: The sign has nothing to do with weather: it shows stones falling from a rock face and warns of falling rocks (caduta massi).

1dis4q7.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a traffic light
1dis4q7.why: This is the traffic light ahead sign (semaforo): it warns of a junction or stretch of road controlled by traffic lights.

de90xu.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
de90xu.why: It has the triangular red-bordered shape of danger signs (segnali di pericolo) and warns of a traffic light ahead.

l41tte.q: In the sign shown, the yellow disc may be replaced by a flashing yellow light
l41tte.why: The central yellow disc can be replaced by a flashing yellow light, to draw even more attention to the traffic light ahead.

1x0x3l5.q: When you see the sign shown you must reduce speed so you can stop if necessary
1x0x3l5.why: The traffic light may turn amber or red, so you must slow down to be able to stop in time.

cg6r0g.q: The sign shown has a yellow background if placed before roadworks
cg6r0g.why: Like all danger signs, it has a yellow background when placed before roadworks (cantiere stradale), for example for a temporary traffic light.

19kagxs.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a traffic light with the lights arranged vertically
19kagxs.why: The sign shows red, amber and green lights arranged vertically, as on the traffic light; for horizontally arranged lights a horizontal version of the sign is used.

11dfvru.q: The sign shown is mandatory on roads outside built-up areas
11dfvru.why: Outside built-up areas, on extra-urban roads (strade extraurbane), the traffic light warning sign must always be installed; in built-up areas it is optional.

19x79z2.q: On roads outside built-up areas the sign is always mandatory
19x79z2.why: The traffic light warning sign is mandatory on extra-urban roads (strade extraurbane), where speeds are higher; in built-up areas installing it is optional.

1sdj758.q: The sign shown may have the red disc replaced by a flashing red light
1sdj758.why: Only the yellow disc can be replaced by a flashing yellow light; the red disc always stays as it is.

1unvc0y.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a railway crossing without barriers
1unvc0y.why: The sign warns of a traffic light; a level crossing without barriers (passaggio a livello senza barriere) is shown by a sign with a locomotive.

hqq77t.q: The sign shown may give advance notice of a level crossing with half-barriers
hqq77t.why: The sign warns of a traffic light; a level crossing with barriers or half-barriers (semibarriere) has its own sign showing a gate.

1y910jn.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an alternating one-way section
1y910jn.why: The sign warns of traffic lights in general; an alternating one-way section (senso unico alternato) may be controlled by lights, but this sign does not indicate it by itself.

1toy4it.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a moving bridge
1toy4it.why: The sign shows the three lights of a traffic light and warns of one ahead; a moving bridge (ponte mobile) has its own specific danger sign.

67l4z.q: The sign shown may have a steady yellow light in the centre
67l4z.why: The central yellow disc can only be replaced by a flashing yellow light, not a steady one.

1aky0ap.q: The sign shown warns of the possibility of sudden dazzle caused by low-flying aircraft
1aky0ap.why: The low-flying aircraft sign (aeromobili) warns of planes passing low overhead, whose lights can cause sudden dazzle.

fwgyo6.q: The sign shown warns of the possibility of a sudden, loud noise caused by low-flying aircraft
fwgyo6.why: Low-flying aircraft can make a sudden, loud noise that may startle or distract the driver.

klw986.q: The sign shown is placed near airports
klw986.why: The aircraft sign is placed near airports, where planes fly low over the road.

1n6aypj.q: The sign shown is placed near take-off and landing runways for aircraft
1n6aypj.why: The sign warns of low-flying aircraft, typical of areas near take-off and landing runways.

ehsbj7.q: The sign shown is placed in areas where aircraft may fly at low altitude
ehsbj7.why: The sign is placed where planes may fly low, with a risk of dazzle or sudden noise.

c9csjw.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a gliding site
c9csjw.why: The sign warns of low-flying aircraft near airports or runways, not a gliding site (volo a vela).

1wdt4dv.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an area reserved for Air Force vehicles
1wdt4dv.why: It is a danger sign warning of low-flying aircraft; it does not reserve any area for military vehicles.

1gk50bj.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a junction leading to the airport
1gk50bj.why: The sign warns of the danger of low-flying aircraft; directions to the airport are given by information signs (segnali di indicazione).

1n0wpvr.q: The sign shown prohibits access to airports
1n0wpvr.why: It is a danger sign, not a prohibition sign: it warns of low-flying aircraft and does not forbid any access.

1ul2fjc.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a lane reserved for entering the airport
1ul2fjc.why: The sign warns of the danger of low-flying aircraft; reserved lanes are shown by mandatory or information signs.

exsrd0.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road subject to strong gusts of crosswind
exsrd0.why: The windsock shown indicates the danger of strong crosswind (vento laterale), which can push the vehicle sideways, especially on leaving tunnels or on viaducts.

14y3ppr.q: The sign shown warns of possible strong crosswind gusts on exiting a tunnel.
14y3ppr.why: On leaving a tunnel the vehicle moves from a sheltered area into an exposed one, so side gusts hit suddenly; this is a typical place for the crosswind sign (forte vento laterale).

ou0mwr.q: The sign shown warns of a viaduct exposed to sudden crosswind gusts.
ou0mwr.why: Viaducts are high and unsheltered, so they are often exposed to sudden side gusts; the windsock sign (forte vento laterale) warns of them.

7iuqus.q: The sign shown warns of areas subject to strong, sudden crosswind gusts.
7iuqus.why: The crosswind sign (forte vento laterale), showing a windsock, warns of stretches, viaducts or tunnel exits exposed to sudden side gusts.

1w9jljh.q: The sign shown warns of a danger that is greater for vehicles with tarpaulin or box bodies.
1w9jljh.why: Vehicles with tarpaulin covers or box bodies (telonati o furgonati) have a large side surface for the wind to push on, so they are more likely to swerve or tip over.

m7n5ub.q: The sign shown advises proceeding with caution while holding the steering wheel firmly.
m7n5ub.why: A side gust can suddenly push the vehicle off line, so you should slow down and grip the steering wheel firmly to correct your path.

bczsb6.q: The sign shown warns of a danger that, in strong crosswinds, is greater for vehicles towing trailers.
bczsb6.why: A trailer adds extra surface for the wind to catch and can sway or snake, making the whole combination less stable in strong crosswinds.

b0re6n.q: The sign shown warns of a danger that, in strong crosswinds, is greater for two-wheeled vehicles.
b0re6n.why: Motorcycles and bicycles are light and have little lateral stability, so a sudden gust can easily push them sideways or make them fall.

wk0b0f.q: The sign shown warns of a danger that, in strong crosswinds, is greater for vehicles towing caravans.
wk0b0f.why: A caravan is tall, light and has wide sides, so crosswinds make it sway and can destabilise the whole combination with the towing vehicle.

17moox0.q: The sign shown requires, in strong crosswinds, proceeding with caution and holding the steering wheel with a firmer grip.
17moox0.why: In strong crosswinds you must slow down and grip the wheel firmly to counter the sudden sideways shifts caused by gusts.

4hx0bj.q: The sign shown indicates that, in strong crosswinds, vehicles with tarpaulin covers may need to slow down and, if necessary, stop.
4hx0bj.why: Tarpaulin-covered vehicles (veicoli telonati) are very exposed because of their large side surface; in strong gusts they must slow down and, if the danger is serious, stop safely.

1hevf20.q: The sign shown warns that, in strong crosswinds, oncoming vehicles may swerve.
1hevf20.why: Gusts can also push oncoming vehicles into your lane, so you need caution and an adequate side clearance.

9maqft.q: The sign shown warns of a danger that, in strong crosswinds, increases as the vehicle's side surface area increases.
9maqft.why: The larger the vehicle's side area, the stronger the push of the crosswind; vans, tarpaulin trucks and caravans are the most exposed.

qnk9p9.q: The sign shown warns of low-flying aircraft.
qnk9p9.why: The windsock sign means strong crosswind (forte vento laterale), i.e. areas exposed to sudden side gusts; low-flying aircraft have their own sign showing an aeroplane.

1kq93x5.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road near an airport.
1kq93x5.why: The windsock sign means strong crosswind (forte vento laterale), i.e. areas exposed to sudden side gusts, not the proximity of an airport.

ezcenx.q: The sign shown warns of an airfield.
ezcenx.why: The windsock sign means strong crosswind (forte vento laterale), i.e. areas exposed to sudden side gusts, not the presence of an airfield.

9shdkc.q: The sign shown indicates the direction the wind is coming from.
9shdkc.why: The sign only warns of an area subject to strong crosswinds; the windsock drawing is symbolic and does not show the actual wind direction.

1yg2mr1.q: The sign shown warns of a nearby playground.
1yg2mr1.why: The windsock sign means strong crosswind (forte vento laterale), i.e. areas exposed to sudden side gusts; the windsock does not represent a playground.

w1fp81.q: The sign shown warns of industrial sheds nearby.
w1fp81.why: The windsock sign means strong crosswind (forte vento laterale), i.e. areas exposed to sudden side gusts, not industrial buildings.

1324wlh.q: The sign shown warns that, in strong crosswinds, the danger is greater at tunnel entrances for narrow, tall vehicles.
1324wlh.why: The danger is greater on exiting tunnels, when you move from a sheltered to an exposed area, and for vehicles with a large side surface.

1877ngl.q: The sign shown warns of an area where, in strong crosswinds, vehicles with trailers have better road holding.
1877ngl.why: In strong crosswinds vehicles with trailers are less stable, because the trailer catches the wind and can sway or snake.

hknbl7.q: The sign shown warns of an area where, in strong crosswinds, empty or light vehicles have better road holding.
hknbl7.why: Empty or light vehicles are more easily pushed by the wind, so in side gusts they have less road holding.

j1e74.q: The sign shown warns of a danger that, in strong crosswinds, is lower for vehicles with bulky loads on the roof.
j1e74.why: Bulky roof loads increase the surface exposed to the wind and raise the centre of gravity, so the danger for these vehicles is greater.

o5wtvx.q: The sign shown allows overtaking with a reduced side distance from the vehicle being overtaken in strong crosswinds.
o5wtvx.why: In strong crosswinds vehicles can swerve suddenly, so when overtaking you must increase, not reduce, the side distance.

2zs920.q: The sign shown warns of a tunnel entrance.
2zs920.why: The windsock sign means strong crosswind (forte vento laterale), i.e. areas exposed to sudden side gusts; a tunnel entrance has its own specific sign.

925jro.q: The sign shown warns of possible ice on the road.
925jro.why: The windsock sign means strong crosswind (forte vento laterale), i.e. areas exposed to sudden side gusts; ice is signalled by the slippery-road-due-to-ice sign or by the other-dangers sign with a panel.

ixmgce.q: The sign shown warns that you are passing through an area at risk of fire.
ixmgce.why: The fire danger sign (pericolo di incendio), showing a tree and a lit match, warns of areas such as woods or dry brush where a fire can easily start.

1luwvaz.q: The sign shown warns of the proximity of areas at high risk of fire.
1luwvaz.why: The sign with a tree and a lit match warns of nearby areas at high fire risk, where throwing lit objects is forbidden.

156pzgo.q: The sign shown indicates that you are approaching easily flammable woodland.
156pzgo.why: The fire danger sign (pericolo di incendio) warns of easily flammable woods or vegetation beside the road.

17najew.q: The sign shown warns of roadside areas at high risk of fire.
17najew.why: The sign indicates that the areas alongside the road, such as woods and dry brush, are at high fire risk.

8im0v4.q: The sign shown is supplemented by the panel indicating the length of the affected stretch of road.
8im0v4.why: The fire danger sign is supplemented by the length panel (estesa), showing how many metres or kilometres the risk area extends.

ti2rfs.q: Where this sign is present, if the driver or passengers break the ban on throwing lit cigarettes out of the window, a fire may start.
ti2rfs.why: The sign marks areas with easily flammable vegetation, so a lit cigarette butt thrown from the window can start a fire.

j401h8.q: The sign shown warns that you are passing through an area at risk of explosions.
j401h8.why: The sign with a tree and a lit match warns of fire danger (pericolo di incendio) in vegetation, not of explosions.

12bsrbj.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road lined by stone quarries, with danger of explosions.
12bsrbj.why: The sign with a tree and a lit match warns of fire danger (pericolo di incendio) in wooded areas, not quarries with blasting.

198acrc.q: The sign shown prohibits transit to vehicles carrying explosives.
198acrc.why: It is a triangular danger sign and prohibits nothing; it warns of fire risk. The ban on vehicles carrying explosives is a specific round sign.

9o2znn.q: The sign shown prohibits transit to vehicles carrying highly flammable products.
9o2znn.why: It is a triangular danger sign warning of fire risk, not a prohibition; dangerous goods are banned with a specific round sign.

1vssent.q: The sign shown prohibits transit to vehicles carrying flammable liquids.
1vssent.why: This is a danger sign warning of high fire-risk areas; it does not ban any vehicle from passing.

p3994s.q: The sign shown warns of possible strong crosswinds.
p3994s.why: The sign with a tree and a lit match warns of fire danger (pericolo di incendio); strong crosswind has its own sign showing a windsock.

12013jf.q: The sign shown warns of a junction of two or more rural roads regulated as a roundabout.
12013jf.why: The roundabout sign (circolazione rotatoria), with three arrows in a circle, warns of a junction where traffic circulates around a central island in the direction of the arrows.

1qmbvya.q: The sign shown warns of a junction of several roads where traffic circulates in the direction shown by the arrows.
1qmbvya.why: The sign warns of a roundabout: vehicles must go around the central island in the anticlockwise direction shown by the arrows.

11fzl6y.q: The sign shown may also be used in built-up areas.
11fzl6y.why: The roundabout warning sign is used both outside and inside built-up areas, where it is normally placed closer than 150 metres.

13cl4g1.q: The sign shown prohibits turning right at the first junction.
13cl4g1.why: The triangular sign with three arrows in a circle warns of a roundabout (circolazione rotatoria); it is a danger sign and does not ban any turn.

1o0hk2v.q: The sign shown warns of a dead-end road, so you have to turn back.
1o0hk2v.why: The triangular sign with three arrows in a circle warns of a roundabout (circolazione rotatoria), not a dead end, which is shown by a rectangular information sign.

wful66.q: The sign shown warns of a compulsory left turn.
wful66.why: The triangular sign with three arrows in a circle warns of a roundabout (circolazione rotatoria); mandatory directions are shown by round blue signs.

o70han.q: The sign shown warns of a danger other than those for which specific signs exist.
o70han.why: The other-dangers sign (altri pericoli), an exclamation mark, is used for hazards without a specific sign, usually with a supplementary panel specifying the hazard.

1rjs9jy.q: The sign shown indicates that caution is needed because a danger is near.
1rjs9jy.why: Like every danger sign, other dangers (altri pericoli) warns of a hazard about 150 metres ahead and requires you to slow down and pay attention.

1dd6a65.q: The sign shown may be used without supplementary panels to indicate a generic danger in an emergency.
1dd6a65.why: In emergencies the other-dangers sign (altri pericoli) may be used on its own, without a supplementary panel, to signal a generic hazard.

w0bb3x.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road in poor condition or with an uneven surface.
w0bb3x.why: The exclamation mark is the other-dangers sign (altri pericoli), used for hazards without a specific sign; an uneven road has its own specific sign.

1qy4f6q.q: The sign shown indicates that you must go straight ahead.
1qy4f6q.why: The exclamation mark is the other-dangers sign (altri pericoli), used for hazards without a specific sign; it does not impose a direction, which is done by round blue mandatory signs.

13ypmv6.q: The sign shown warns of a steep ascent.
13ypmv6.why: The exclamation mark is the other-dangers sign (altri pericoli), used for hazards without a specific sign; a steep ascent has its own sign showing the gradient as a percentage.

dqjd.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), warns that ice may form.
dqjd.why: The other-dangers sign with the blue panel showing snowflakes warns that ice may form on the road surface.

7xhjaq.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), warns of shunting tracks at industrial plants.
7xhjaq.why: The panel with locomotives, combined with other dangers (altri pericoli), warns of shunting tracks crossing the road at industrial plants or ports.

1yo10tm.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), warns that snowploughs may be working on the road.
1yo10tm.why: The panel with a snowflake and a snowplough, combined with other dangers, warns of snowploughs (sgombraneve) working on the road.

1d1ivm0.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), warns of a level crossing without barriers.
1d1ivm0.why: The locomotive panel indicates shunting tracks at industrial plants; a level crossing without barriers is signalled by the train-in-triangle sign and the Saint Andrew's cross.

jwors1.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), warns of military vehicles manoeuvring.
jwors1.why: The panel shows a construction machine, so the sign warns of roadwork machinery (mezzi d'opera) in operation, not military vehicles.

owmbyg.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with a soft verge.
owmbyg.why: The dangerous verge sign (banchina pericolosa) warns of a soft or unusable hard shoulder (banchina) where wheels may sink or slip.

1mgvcz2.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with an unusable verge.
1mgvcz2.why: The dangerous verge sign means the hard shoulder (banchina) cannot be used: do not drive onto it or stop on it.

kjk016.q: The sign shown warns of a possible danger of falling into the roadside ditch.
kjk016.why: With a soft verge, if the wheels leave the carriageway the vehicle may slide into the roadside ditch (cunetta).

1hu9dxe.q: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with a dangerous verge.
1hu9dxe.why: The sign is called dangerous verge (banchina pericolosa): the hard shoulder is soft or unusable.

46qkfy.q: The sign shown is a danger sign.
46qkfy.why: It is triangular with a red border, like all danger signs, and warns of a dangerous verge (banchina pericolosa).

1cwchse.q: Where the sign shown is present, it is advisable not to get too close to the right-hand edge of the road.
1cwchse.why: The verge is soft or unusable, so it is wise to keep away from the right edge so your wheels do not leave the carriageway.

5lxndc.q: The sign shown must be supplemented by a speed limit sign.
5lxndc.why: The dangerous verge sign (banchina pericolosa) warns that the hard shoulder is soft or unusable; it does not need to be paired with a speed limit sign.

3xgr1m.q: The sign shown is an information sign.
3xgr1m.why: It is a danger sign, triangular with a red border; information signs are usually rectangular.

13wgff9.q: The sign shown indicates a ban on continuing along that road.
13wgff9.why: The dangerous verge sign (banchina pericolosa) warns that the hard shoulder is soft or unusable; it is a danger sign and does not forbid continuing.

em2ifc.q: The sign shown warns of a road in bad condition.
em2ifc.why: The dangerous verge sign (banchina pericolosa) warns that the hard shoulder is soft or unusable; a damaged or uneven road has a different sign.

igj4bz.q: The sign shown warns of loose gravel on the road surface.
igj4bz.why: The dangerous verge sign (banchina pericolosa) warns that the hard shoulder is soft or unusable; loose gravel has its own sign showing a car throwing up stones.

4rr5ns.q: The sign shown warns of danger of flooding of the carriageway.
4rr5ns.why: The dangerous verge sign (banchina pericolosa) warns that the hard shoulder is soft or unusable, not a risk of the road flooding.

r0fnc6.q: The sign shown warns of the road leading onto a quay.
r0fnc6.why: The dangerous verge sign (banchina pericolosa) warns that the hard shoulder is soft or unusable; a road leading onto a quay or riverbank has its own sign showing a car falling into water.

1d8yu18.q: The sign shown warns of traffic lights with the lights arranged horizontally.
1d8yu18.why: The traffic light warning sign with three discs side by side warns of traffic lights arranged horizontally.

1k4pa65.q: The sign shown is a danger sign.
1k4pa65.why: It is triangular with a red border, like all danger signs, and warns of traffic lights ahead.

1mfwfnb.q: In the sign shown, the yellow disc may be replaced by a flashing yellow light.
1mfwfnb.why: In the traffic light warning sign, the yellow disc may be replaced by a flashing yellow light to draw more attention.

6l4r79.q: The sign shown indicates that you must moderate your speed so that you can stop if necessary.
6l4r79.why: The sign warns of traffic lights that may be red or amber, so you must slow down to be able to stop in time.

sudiz2.q: The sign shown is normally placed 150 metres before a traffic light.
sudiz2.why: Like all danger signs, the traffic light warning is normally placed 150 metres before the hazard, except for shorter distances in built-up areas.

1nlb557.q: The sign shown indicates the obligation to stop at a police roadblock.
1nlb557.why: The sign with three coloured discs warns of traffic lights (semaforo); a police checkpoint has its own sign requiring you to stop.

7xz0se.q: The sign shown warns of a movable bridge.
7xz0se.why: The sign with three coloured discs warns of traffic lights (semaforo); a movable bridge has its own sign showing a raised bridge.

1hq3xim.q: The sign shown warns of access to a ferry boarding pier.
1hq3xim.why: The sign with three coloured discs warns of traffic lights (semaforo), not access to a ferry pier.

rqhni7.q: The sign shown may have its red disc replaced by a flashing red light.
rqhni7.why: Only the yellow disc may be replaced by a flashing yellow light; the red disc cannot be replaced by a flashing light.

18w0d77.q: The sign shown warns of an unguarded railway crossing.
18w0d77.why: The sign with three coloured discs warns of traffic lights (semaforo); an unguarded level crossing is signalled by a locomotive in the triangle.

19tr4qy.q: The sign shown warns of a level crossing with half-barriers.
19tr4qy.why: The sign with three coloured discs warns of traffic lights (semaforo); a level crossing with barriers or half-barriers has its own sign showing a gate.

1bh3uqq.q: The sign shown warns of reversible lanes.
1bh3uqq.why: The sign with three coloured discs warns of traffic lights (semaforo), not reversible lanes, which are shown by lane-control lights above the lanes.

o73sfo.q: The sign shown warns of a cycle crossing.
o73sfo.why: The sign with three coloured discs warns of traffic lights (semaforo); a cycle crossing has its own sign showing a bicycle.
